logline: The forged DNA results threaten to throw Maya out of the mansion, until a loyal servant reveals what she overheard.
continuity_notes: Takes place the next morning; sunlight through the east windows.
Gita, the housekeeper, wears a green sari and a key ring on her waist.
The red-sealed envelope reappears in Scene 1.

EPISODE NUMBER: 3
EPISODE LOGLINE: The forged DNA results threaten to throw Maya out of the mansion, until a loyal servant reveals what she overheard.

- Takes place the next morning; sunlight through the east windows.

SCENE 1: INT. MALHOTRA MANSION - DINING ROOM - DAY
SCENE START: 00:00:00 | SCENE END: 00:00:56
CAMERA: Symmetrical wide shot of the long breakfast table.
[00:00:00 - 00:00:05] ACTION: The family eats in silence. Maya sits at the far end, untouched plate.
[00:00:05 - 00:00:10] ACTION: Rhea places the red-sealed envelope beside Savitri's tea.
[00:00:10 - 00:00:15] RHEA: The lab rushed it as a courtesy to you, Dadi. I thought you'd want to know at once.
[00:00:15 - 00:00:20] SAVITRI: We sent the samples yesterday evening. How is this possible?
[00:00:20 - 00:00:24] RHEA: Money makes many things possible. Open it.
[00:00:24 - 00:00:30] ACTION: Savitri breaks the seal. Reads. Her face hardens. She slides the page toward Maya.
[00:00:30 - 00:00:35] SAVITRI: Zero percent match. You are not my blood.
[00:00:35 - 00:00:40] MAYA: That's a lie. Somebody changed those results.
[00:00:40 - 00:00:45] NANDINI: Security will escort you out. Leave the uniform; it belongs to the hotel.
[00:00:45 - 00:00:51] ACTION: Two guards step forward and grip Maya's arms. Vikram half-rises from his chair.
[00:00:51 - 00:00:56] VIKRAM: Dadi, wait. At least let her—
[00:00:56 - 00:00:56] ACTION: Savitri raises one hand. Vikram falls silent.

SCENE 2: INT. MALHOTRA MANSION - FRONT STEPS - DAY
SCENE START: 00:00:56 | SCENE END: 00:01:44
CAMERA: Slow motion as the front doors open onto blinding sunlight.
[00:00:56 - 00:01:01] ACTION: The guards push Maya down the steps. Her locket snaps and skitters across the stone.
[00:01:01 - 00:01:06] ACTION: Rhea descends behind her and grinds the locket under her heel.
[00:01:06 - 00:01:12] RHEA: You almost had them, didn't you? Go back to carrying trays, sweetheart.
[00:01:12 - 00:01:17] MAYA: You forged it. I know you did. And I will prove it.
[00:01:17 - 00:01:22] RHEA: With what? Your word against a laboratory?
[00:01:22 - 00:01:28] ACTION: Behind them, GITA the housekeeper hurries out, clutching her key ring.
[00:01:28 - 00:01:34] GITA: Not her word, Rhea baby. Mine. I was outside the study last night.
[00:01:34 - 00:01:39] ACTION: Rhea goes pale. Savitri appears in the doorway above them.
[00:01:39 - 00:01:44] SAVITRI: Gita. Say that again. Slowly.

SCENE 3: INT. MALHOTRA MANSION - SAVITRI'S OFFICE - DAY
SCENE START: 00:01:44 | SCENE END: 00:02:30
CAMERA: Locked-off, cold. Savitri behind a vast desk.
[00:01:44 - 00:01:50] GITA: I heard Rhea baby say the lab director owed her a favour. That the results were printed before the test.
[00:01:50 - 00:01:55] RHEA: She's a servant! She'll say anything for money.
[00:01:55 - 00:02:01] SAVITRI: Gita has served this family for thirty-one years. You have been a Malhotra for six.
[00:02:01 - 00:02:06] ACTION: Savitri picks up her phone and dials. She puts it on speaker.
[00:02:06 - 00:02:12] LAB DIRECTOR (V.O.): Madam Malhotra? I... I can explain. Your granddaughter threatened me.
[00:02:12 - 00:02:16] ACTION: Rhea backs toward the door. Nandini grips the back of a chair.
[00:02:16 - 00:02:21] SAVITRI: Run the test again. In front of my lawyer. Today.
[00:02:21 - 00:02:26] ACTION: Maya picks up the crushed locket from her pocket. Inside, behind the photo, a tiny folded paper.
[00:02:26 - 00:02:30] MAYA: (reading) "If anything happens to me, ask Nandini about the fire."
